svg.title: Project Udyam Digital: solution architecture
svg.desc: A small business owner uses a mobile web app (AI advisor, quote, smart KYC, tracker). It calls an Express API with an advisor engine, plan engine, KYC service, orders and tracker, and back office. These use read-only datasets, mocked government services, JSON stores and the Groq LLM, which only sees redacted text.
svg.text: Accel Business · digital acquisition & onboarding for small businesses · YTL Hackathon 2026, Track A
Mobile-first · EN/HI screens · calls the API over HTTPS
Pricing, rules and checks live here: the browser is never trusted

and explains why. Voice input. Plan

Status machine: Quote accepted → KYC verified → Site check →
Technician → Installed → Live. Expected dates from install days. One
Lead score: logistic regression on 5,000 past leads (AUC 0.70; top
20% convert 1.6× the average). Routes leads to field, partner or
text only. API key stays on the server.
